summary: Reports that the Lincoln Laboratory 360/67 passed testing of its network software, including the NCP, ICP, Telnet as user and server, login, CMS access, and operator communication. Everything behaved according to specs. It updates RFC 193 and was replaced by RFC 214.

eli5.summary: A short test report that says the computer passed all the checks, even when many people used it.

questions: did the lincoln labs 360/67 pass site certification
what network software was tested on the 360/67
